project_info.theme: Approximately four-page live-action cosplay swimsuit fashion magazine
project_info.creative_direction: Polished summer magazine layout with varied swimwear styling, resort photography, and restrained editorial typography
project_info.color_palette: white, lavender, pale blue, coral, tropical green, sand, and soft ocean highlights

main_subject.detail: adult model portraying a fictional horned fantasy character with long dark hair and consistent face and costume continuity
main_subject.wardrobe: a variety of tasteful commercially styled swimsuits in different colors, patterns, and shapes, with coordinated accessories
main_subject.expression_and_pose: varied confident, relaxed, thoughtful, and cheerful fashion poses; no sexualized gestures or suggestive facial expressions

composition_elements.framing: approximately four-page magazine spread with a cover, feature page, image grid, and resort editorial page
composition_elements.environment: bright poolside, beach, and tropical resort settings with clean editorial backgrounds
composition_elements.layout: magazine-style catchphrases, titles, small captions, and page numbers; no personal profile section
composition_elements.effects: use glitter, grain, and scattered light sparingly only where needed; maintain stable limbs and harmonious page balance

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large soft daylight source at approximately 5600K with subtle reflector fill and controlled pool bounce
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: clean summer highlights, soft shadows, accurate swimsuit color, natural skin texture, and restrained editorial polish

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame fashion photography with 50mm and 85mm lenses, art-directed magazine layout
technical_specs.finish: high detail with stable anatomy, subtle film grain, controlled sparkle, clean typography, and balanced whitespace

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an approximately four-page swimsuit fashion magazine featuring a live-action cosplay of a fictional fantasy character as the main subject. Use a clearly adult fashion model with long dark hair, consistent facial structure, and tasteful commercially styled swimsuits in varied colors, patterns, and shapes, with coordinated hairstyles and accessories. Use a wide range of confident, relaxed, thoughtful, and cheerful fashion expressions and poses, avoiding sexualized gestures or suggestive facial expressions. Build a cover, feature spread, image grid, and tropical resort page with magazine-style catchphrases, titles, captions, and page numbers; no personal profile section. Use bright poolside, beach, and tropical settings, restrained glitter and grain only where needed, stable limbs, coherent anatomy, 50mm and 85mm fashion lenses, approximately 5600K daylight, subtle reflector fill, natural skin texture, and a harmonious premium layout.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, suggestive facial expression, lip biting, tongue out, ambiguous age, childlike styling, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed limbs, broken page grid, illegible typography
